newsitem.title: GERMANY: Early German grain yield forecast mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: Early German grain yield forecast mostly lower.

text.p: Preliminary German grain yield forecasts for the 1997 harvest point to mostly lower yields, compared with the 1996 result, data from the federal statistics office showed.
The exception was winter barley, where yields last year turned out below initial forecasts as a result of winter damage.
An analyst pointed out the forecast, which is the result of trend calculations and weather data, was based on developments up to mid-April and could still change considerably.
The institute is due to publish results taking in May and June weather data closer to the harvest.
It offered tentative yield forecasts as follows, also compared to those made a year ago for the 1996 harvest and the final 1996 harvest result in tonnes per hectare (tph) --
winter wheat rye winter barley spring barley oats
